svg.title: R028 — Voltage with a stated continuation model
svg.desc: R028 — Voltage with a stated continuation model
svg.text: R028 — Voltage with a stated continuation model
Example: C₁ = C₂ = 1 pF, I₁ = 0.1 mA, β = 1 mA/V²; λ = 0.
Off until 7 ns; saturation → triode at 14.698 ns; peak current ≈ 0.40844 mA.
Extension: V_X minimum ≈ −75.65 mV at 19.840 ns; I_X has a small negative tail.
